learned_contracts.description: If both supported interval dates are present, compute inclusive overlap within the query year and test whether twice that overlap exceeds the number of days in the year. This primitive-date result takes precedence over a conflicting derived residence boolean. If a complete interval is unavailable, an expressly GIVEN scoped residence intermediate remains admissible; otherwise the helper reports the missing observation.
learned_contracts.name: more_than_half_taxable_year_resolution
